plotSections.title: Staff of the Lantern Keeper
bullets: Ord plans to take the lantern-staff into the woods and speak its inscription again. He remembers the words but does not have them written down.

Sylan remembers one of the paired items as the Staff of the Lantern Keeper, which the DM confirms. The lantern's name is still wrong in memory: Ord offers 'lantern of the staff keeper,' and Sylan says the real name was weirder.

Ord remembers the lantern and staff as fused and no longer separable. Sylan asks whether they should be tried separately and whether they are actually fused; that is not settled in this chunk. Sylan treats the fusion, if true, as having been part of the plan.

The lantern is hooded and finely made. Detect Magic showed an aura of evocation. It has two settings, and one of them blinded an entire room. Saying the words made something happen; trying to undo it made something else happen, and the effect was hard to dismiss. Ord is using a shield, so a sword plus this lantern is the working picture.

plotSections.title: White dragon's hoard
bullets: The items come from the white dragon's hoard. The DM's notes date that treasure to November 3 of the previous year. Dana still has the inventory; she did not write down most of the magic items because the broom she received is the one she tracked.
Counted wealth: about two dozen gemstones, art objects, mundane goods, 500 platinum, 60,000 gold, 11,000 silver, and 4,100 copper. Sylan remembers four or five magic items.

Other hoard pieces Dana lists: a small shrine with a statuette, a brazier, and an altar to a god of dragon minions; a scroll with a poem; the skull of a fiend or celestial; seven candlesticks marked with a holy symbol; a gold bracelet; a gold locket with a painted portrait; a copper chalice; carved bone statuettes (she thinks two); Dana's magic broom and a set of bone dice.

Sylan gave the gold birdcage from that hoard to the crew. A box of turquoise animal figurines was also in the hoard; Ord inspected them and left them behind, and Sylan suspects they might turn into creatures.

Dana identifies the undead lady tied to this hoard as Lady Meriwether, named in the manner of Merryweather from Sleeping Beauty. The white dragon's own name does not get recovered; Sylan's line that his name is 'Lost of Time' reads as the name being lost to time.

plotSections.title: Ciri's starburst item and Walker's hat
bullets: A separate hoard item, a ring or bracelet, went to Ciri. It shoots starbursts that turn into fireballs. Sylan's guesses were nightfall, night-something, or starfall. Nobody present remembers the item's name, and Ciri is away.
Sylan starts to say the group needs Walker back in order to figure out whether Walker's hat is something. The sentence is cut off.

chronologicalEvents: While placing stronghold people, Sylan does not remember Koji being among them. Ord describes a small gold person who makes something gold; the DM identifies that person as Ord's roommate, and Ord names the roommate Ponchi.
Ord heads for the woods to recite the inscription on the fused lantern-staff.
Sylan and the DM confirm one item as the Staff of the Lantern Keeper. The paired lantern's name stays unresolved, as does whether the two can still be separated.

Dana reads her notes from the white dragon's hoard, dated in the DM's notes to November 3 of the previous year, including the coin totals, shrine to a god of dragon minions, and the other art and magic pieces.
Sylan recalls giving the hoard's gold birdcage to the crew. The DM adds a box of turquoise animal figurines, which Ord had inspected and left behind.
Ord recalls the hooded lantern's evocation aura and the blinding setting. Sylan remembers not to look at it when it goes off.
Dana says Ciri holds the ring or bracelet that fires starbursts which become fireballs. Ciri is not there to name it.
Sylan begins a question about Walker's hat and the chunk ends.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Has the hooded, finely made lantern fused in his memory to the Staff of the Lantern Keeper, and is taking it into the woods to speak the inscription from memory.

Detect Magic on the lantern showed an aura of evocation. Two settings; one blinded the whole room. The command words triggered an effect, undoing it triggered another, and the effect was hard to remove.
Currently uses a shield. Inspected the turquoise animal figurines from the white dragon hoard and left them behind.
Ponchi is his roommate.
Remembers the staff as the Staff of the Lantern Keeper and wants the lantern inscription tried on its own if the pieces can be separated.

Remembers the lantern's blinding setting and does not want to be looking at it when Ord sets it off.
